dashboard.label: Splunk ES Admin Operations Center
dashboard.description: Administration, MCO, capacity, ingestion, change and continuity controls for Splunk Enterprise Security.

div.p: Service health, capacity, data freshness, scheduler reliability, change readiness and continuity evidence.

search.query: | rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval state="RESPONDING" | fields state
| rest /services/data/indexes count=0 | search disabled=0 | stats count as active_indexes
index=_internal source="*scheduler.log" status=skipped | stats count as skipped_searches
| tstats latest(_time) as last_event where index=sysmon OR index=windows by index sourcetype | eval age_seconds=now()-last_event | where age_seconds>900 | stats count as stale_sources
| inputlookup admin_mco_control_register.csv | stats count as controls

| rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval role=mvjoin(server_roles,", ") | eval management_state="RESPONDING" | rename serverName as instance version as splunk_version build as splunk_build os_name as operating_system | table instance management_state splunk_version splunk_build operating_system role

| rest /services/server/health/splunkd/details count=0 | eval state=upper(health) | where state!="GREEN" | rename feature as health_feature reason as diagnostic | table state health_feature diagnostic | appendpipe [ stats count | where count=0 | eval state="GREEN", health_feature="No active platform anomaly", diagnostic="Health endpoint returned no non-green feature" | fields state health_feature diagnostic ]

| rest /services/data/indexes count=0 | search disabled=0 | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,0) | eval used_mb=round(currentDBSizeMB,1) | eval capacity_pct=round((currentDBSizeMB/maxTotalDataSizeMB)*100,1) | eval state=case(capacity_pct>=90,"ACTION",capacity_pct>=75,"WATCH",1=1,"GREEN") | rename title as index maxTotalDataSizeMB as max_mb totalEventCount as lifetime_events | table state index lifetime_events used_mb max_mb capacity_pct retention_days | sort 0 - capacity_pct

index=_internal source="*scheduler.log" | eval outcome=case(status="success","SUCCESS",status="skipped","SKIPPED",isnotnull(status),upper(status),1=1,"OTHER") | timechart span=1h count by outcome useother=f usenull=f

| tstats count latest(_time) as last_event where index=sysmon OR index=windows by index sourcetype host | eval age_seconds=now()-last_event | eval freshness=case(age_seconds<=300,"GREEN",age_seconds<=900,"WATCH",1=1,"ACTION") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_event,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table freshness index sourcetype host count last_seen age_seconds | sort 0 - age_seconds

index=_internal source="*metrics.log" group=queue | eval fill_pct=if(max_size_kb>0,round((current_size_kb/max_size_kb)*100,1),0) | where fill_pct>0 | timechart span=5m max(fill_pct) by name limit=8 useother=f

table.title: MCO control register / owner-ready evidence map

search.query: | inputlookup admin_mco_control_register.csv | fields domain control source green_condition frequency evidence runbook | sort domain control

table.title: Change, TLS, upgrade and continuity gates

search.query: | inputlookup admin_mco_control_register.csv | search domain=Change OR domain=TLS OR domain=Upgrade OR domain=Cluster OR domain=Continuity | eval operating_gate=case(domain="TLS","CHAIN / SAN / EXPIRY / ROLLBACK",domain="Upgrade","COMPATIBILITY / BACKUP / SMOKE / ROLLBACK",domain="Cluster","RF-SF / QUORUM / ROLLING",domain="Continuity","RESTORE / RTO / RPO",1=1,"BTOOL / MANIFEST / SMOKE") | table domain control operating_gate frequency evidence runbook | sort domain control
